desc: The goal is created via create_goal.
The model must actually attempt the fetch before blocking.

update_goal(blocked) must not fire on the first turn (the harness grades the final state, so this rejects a call in the first turn's tool stream only if present there; the case input enforces the three-turn policy).
complete_goal is removed and must not be called.
If the URL could not be fetched, result.json must not exist (no fabrication).
